key.name: notch-enabled
key.description: The notch at the top of the screen, with live activities and the hub. Spotlight search and the auto-hiding top bar live inside the notch, so they are off while it is off. When off, GNOME's own clock comes back.

key.name: show-system
key.summary: Show system monitor in expanded view

key.name: hide-datemenu
key.summary: Hide the built-in GNOME clock / date menu

key.name: show-date
key.summary: Show date next to time in collapsed pill

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Applied to every state; the collapsed pill becomes a capsule automatically when the radius exceeds half its height.

key.name: island-style
key.description: notch: attached to the top screen edge with rounded bottom corners (MacBook style). floating: fully rounded island below the edge.

key.name: top-margin
key.summary: Gap between the top screen edge and the island (floating style)

key.name: enable-shadow
key.summary: Draw a soft shadow that follows the island shape

key.name: hover-delay
key.summary: Hover time before the island reacts (ms)

key.name: collapse-delay
key.summary: Delay before collapsing after the pointer leaves (ms)

key.name: expand-on-hover
key.description: When off, hovering shows a compact preview and a click expands.

key.name: pill-gestures
key.summary: Scroll and swipe on the notch
key.description: Scroll up or down over the notch to change the volume; swipe sideways to skip tracks.

key.name: auto-collapse
key.summary: Collapse automatically when the pointer leaves
key.description: When off, click the clock header (or use the shortcut) to collapse.

key.name: always-show-clock
key.summary: Keep the clock visible while media is shown in the pill

key.name: always-show-media
key.summary: Keep paused media in the pill (otherwise only while playing)

key.name: autohide-top-bar
key.description: The GNOME top bar slides away and reappears when the pointer touches the top edge outside the island. Windows start just below the island instead of below the top bar.

key.name: fill-top-strip
key.summary: Paint the strip beside the island
key.description: With the top bar hidden, fill the space beside the island with the island color while an app window is open, so it looks like one black bar (MacBook style). On an empty desktop, and when off, the wallpaper shows through.

key.name: eq-follow-audio
key.description: Analyses the default output (not the microphone) while music plays and the pill is visible. Off: the bars use a simple animation.

key.name: pill-show-weather
key.summary: Show current temperature in the collapsed pill

key.name: pill-show-system
key.summary: Show CPU / RAM / temperature in the collapsed pill

key.name: notif-auto-dismiss
key.summary: Auto-dismiss banner notifications after N seconds (0=disabled)

key.name: notif-suppress-native
key.summary: Auto-dismiss native banner when notch peek shows

key.name: show-media
key.summary: Media tab and media in the collapsed pill

key.name: event-media
key.summary: Show "Now Playing" when the track changes

key.name: event-volume
key.summary: Show volume changes in the island

key.name: event-brightness
key.summary: Show screen brightness changes in the island

key.name: event-bluetooth
key.summary: Show Bluetooth device connect / disconnect events

key.name: calendar-lead-minutes
key.summary: Minutes before an event to announce it

key.name: replace-system-osd
key.summary: Hide GNOME's volume/brightness popup when the island shows it

key.name: event-duration
key.summary: How long informational events stay on screen (s)

key.name: dock-autohide
key.description: always: always shown, windows make room. autohide: shown only when the pointer reaches the edge. intelligent: hides when a window overlaps it, and a few seconds after nothing does.

key.name: dock-edge-margin
key.summary: Gap between the Dock and the screen edge

key.name: dock-show-trash
key.summary: Show the Trash in the Dock

key.name: dock-separators
key.summary: Separators between pinned, running and Trash

key.name: shortcut-search
key.description: Super+Space is also GNOME's keyboard-layout switch; with more than one layout configured, pick another shortcut.

key.name: search-replace-overview
key.summary: Search in the island instead of the Overview search bar

key.name: search-files
key.summary: Include files (via the Files app search index)

key.name: glass-menus
key.summary: Glass top-bar menus (Quick Settings, calendar, indicators)

key.name: control-center-style
key.summary: macOS Control Center look for Quick Settings

key.name: zoom-gestures
key.description: Three-finger pinch zooms the screen in and out; three-finger double-tap toggles zoom.

key.name: icon-source
key.description: system: GNOME icons. macos: macOS-style icons from macOSicons.com (needs your own API key), cached locally. custom: only your own icons. Custom per-app icons are always honoured.

key.name: icon-custom-map
key.summary: Per-app custom icon paths (app id → image)

key.name: icon-refresh-days
key.summary: Re-download cached macOS-style icons older than this (0 = never)

key.name: macosicons-key-version
key.summary: Bumped when the macOSicons API key in the keyring changes

key.name: icon-customize-request
key.summary: App id the preferences window should open the icon picker for

key.name: saved-button-layout
key.summary: Window button layout before macOS-style buttons were turned on

key.name: notes-folder
key.summary: Folder where notes are saved as markdown files, one dated subfolder per day (empty = ~/Documents/Notchex Notes)

key.name: weather-location
key.summary: Weather location (city name or lat,lon). Empty = IP auto.

key.name: calendar-enabled-sources
key.summary: If non-empty, only sync events from these GOA account emails

key.name: tasks-enabled-lists
key.summary: If non-empty, only show tasks from these list display names
